streamItems.title: Alpine Linux rebuilds GitLab after attempted RCE attack
streamItems.summary: Hackers attempted to exploit a critical GitLab vulnerability in Alpine Linux's development infrastructure on October 20-21, prompting the open-source project to rebuild its GitLab server and reset all passwords over concerns of a possible compromise. [...]
streamItems.remediation: Board/Executive: Mandate immediate emergency asset sweep for exposed interfaces. Task Execution: Apply vendor patch or emergency WAF virtual patch, audit access logs for IOCs, and restrict management ports.
